bug_semantics: load_human_activity_segmentation_datasets (and the sibling TSSB loader in the same file) parsed CSV cells with Python eval via pandas converters, so a malicious local CSV/zip could execute arbitrary code in the current process. The sink was np.array(eval(val)) on attacker-controlled strings for columns such as change_points and sensor arrays.
